prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Need expert help with phpfox project
Need help with modules and plugins for phpfox project. Will need someone with a lot of experience with phpfox to help us do things the "right" way within the application. This would include authentication and other custom "apps". Will need lots of experience setting up phpfox. Will need experience making "apps".
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need help building phpFox modules, plugins, authentication, and custom apps in a way that fits the application properly.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be glad to help you approach this the right way. I have 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, with a strong focus on full-stack development and clean, maintainable implementation.

While my core background is in modern web application development, the type of work you’re describing is exactly the kind of problem where careful architecture matters most: understanding the platform’s structure, extending it without fighting it, and making sure authentication and custom app behavior are integrated cleanly. I’m comfortable working through complex application logic, following existing patterns, and building features in a way that is stable and easy to maintain.

For this job, I would focus on:
- reviewing the current phpFox setup and extension points
- planning module and plugin work to fit the platform properly
- implementing authentication-related functionality carefully
- building custom app behavior with maintainability in mind
- keeping the work aligned with the “right way” inside the application

I value doing things systematically rather than rushing into code that creates future maintenance issues. If you already have requirements for the specific apps or custom behaviors you need, I can help break them down into a clear implementation plan and then work through them step by step.

If you’re looking for someone who can take the technical side seriously, communicate clearly, and build with structure, I’d be happy to discuss what you need in more detail and see how I can help.
